note: Strategy on CXCR5 × PD-1 — three populations stacked vertically within the CXCR5+ right cluster, plus the entire CXCR5- bulk: (1) CXCR5 is bimodal — locate the dense CXCR5+ cluster on the right. (2) Within the CXCR5+ cluster, find the PD-1 density peak. Tfh (resting / circulating Tfh) occupies the band from the PD-1 peak upward; Tfh_hi_PD1 (activated germinal-center-like Tfh) is the top sliver above this band (PD-1 very high). (3) non_Tfh (non-follicular memory helper T cells) = the entire CXCR5- left cluster PLUS the events in the CXCR5+ right cluster that sit BELOW the PD-1 peak.
tips: T follicular helper identification on memory CD4. CXCR5 is the B-cell follicle homing receptor and the canonical Tfh marker. PD-1 further stratifies Tfh activation state (germinal-center Tfh are PD-1 high). Tfh: CXCR5+ PD-1 intermediate. Tfh_hi_PD1: CXCR5+ PD-1 high. non_Tfh: CXCR5-. Terminology clarification: 'PD-1 intermediate' here should be read as 'not PD-1 high' (covers PD-1 low and mid) so that all CXCR5+ events are assigned to one of the two Tfh bins. Scope: parent is memory CD4 non-Treg (CM+EM+EMRA aggregated); Naive_CD4 and Treg are excluded — Tfh are antigen-experienced. cTfh can be subtyped using CXCR3/CCR6 (in panel) into cTfh1/2/17 — currently not exploited. ICOS and BCL6 (gold-standard Tfh markers) are NOT in panel.
